# baffinbay_routed_dsr (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay Routed DSR traffic configuration by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_routed_dsr" "existing" {
  id = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the remote object to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `announced` (Boolean) Controls if the Routed DSR traffic configuration is announced.
- `deployment_state` (String) The deployment state (DEPLOYED, UNDEPLOYED).
- `name` (String) The name of the Routed DSR traffic configuration.
- `prefix` (String) The CIDR prefix for the Routed DSR traffic configuration.
